description:
Validate vault files against the schemas, reporting violations as path:line: message.

Usage: lint [PATHS...] [--schemas DIR] [--quiet]

Args:
  PATHS — zero or more files to validate; with none, walks the whole vault.

Flags:
  --schemas DIR — schemas directory; defaults to the schemas directory shipped alongside the tool.
  --quiet — suppress per-violation output, leaving only the exit code.

Examples:
  []
  ["--quiet"]
  ["notes/2026-06-14-09-30-00.md"]

Notes:
  Read-only; it never rewrites files.
  Exit 0 when clean, 1 when any violations were found, 2 on a usage or startup failure.
  Run after any batch of writes and before `commit save`.
